name: Tentree

prices.note: Store-wide feed pages 1–6, product type Mens: 164 tee/T-shirt listings, 98 at regular price, 66 marked down only. Every regular-price men's tee is $45 (e.g. Juniper T-Shirt, Getaway T-Shirt, Embroidered Ten T-Shirt), mostly graphic and outdoors themes. Sizes S–XXL. Juniper T-Shirt: 45% recycled polyester, 30% TENCEL Lyocell, 25% organic cotton (product description). About half of the 164 men's tee listings mention a graphic, print, embroidery or design in the description.

notes: Shipping: 'Free U.S. shipping on all orders over $100'; $7.50 under $100. Countries not listed on the page.
Returns: '$10 Returns (includes shipping label), Free Exchanges'; items 30%+ off are final sale; return window in days not stated on the policy page, so returns_days is empty.
Homepage: 'Tentree | Sustainable Clothing—Every Item Plants 10 Trees'; mission 'to restore the planet by planting trees and creating Earth-First, sustainably made apparel'.
